name: Goldrot
description:
About This Game

A blend of tower defense and settlement management where every arrow, boulder, and cannonball must be produced by your servants to defend against relentless Viking raids.

Every Shot Has a Cost

Your defenses don't fire for free. Arrows, boulders, and cannonballs must be produced before they can be used. Assign your servants to gather resources and keep your ammunition stockpiles full.

Manage Your Settlement

Build production buildings, assign servants, and keep your camp running efficiently. Decide what to produce, where to invest your resources, and what your priorities are.

Survive the Raids

Viking attacks grow stronger over time, forcing you to constantly adapt your defenses and production. A powerful fortress is useless without the supplies to defend it.

Features

  • Build and fortify a medieval camp.

  • Gather resources through specialized production buildings.

  • Craft ammunition to power your defensive structures.

  • Defend your fortress against waves of Viking raiders.

  • Balance production to survive increasingly powerful attacks.
